  t.name,
  COALESCE(tc.n, 0) AS permit_count,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts AS t
LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts AS tc
  ON tc.geoid = t.geoid
  AND tc.run_id = 'r_20261025_e926ac'
  AND tc.source = 'm1_city'
  AND tc.grp = 'all'
WHERE t.geoid IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY permit_count DESC, t.name
LIMIT 200
